info.name: Convert a value between two currencies

params.name: from
params.description: The base ("from") currency as a 3-letter code.

params.name: to
params.description: The target ("to") currency as a 3-letter code.

params.name: prettyprint
params.description: Set to true for human-readable response formatting.

items.docs: Converts a monetary value from one currency to another at the latest API rates, returning the original request, the exchange rate and timestamp used, and the converted amount. Available on the Unlimited plan. Validate returned values before using them anywhere transactions are processed.
